# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 21 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 21:1 — the Lord God will avenge this wrong vs. this wrong

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the Lord God will avenge this wrong himself" | Adds 'himself' for emphasis — autos |
| LOGOS | "The Lord God will avenge this wrong himself" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "The Lord God will avenge this himself" | Drops 'wrong' for brevity |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** EMET and LOGOS agree: 'avenge this wrong himself.' PNEUMA's omission of 'wrong' loses specificity. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 21:8 — forty-eight years — textual tradition

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "forty-eight years" | Follows longer recension |
| LOGOS | "forty-eight years" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "forty-eight years" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three agree. No divergence.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of All.

---
